story_overview: Following a major highway crash, Marco presents a CGI schematic for the complex recovery of an overturned truck. At the crash site, a large crew including Casey, Barry, Gus and Vince works through the night to clear the wreckage. Meanwhile, Chuck, a veteran of the towing company, gives an interview about the challenges of the job.

video_prompts:
Marco: Man wearing a yellow high-visibility jacket and a black hard hat adorned with various stickers.
The Schematic View: A computer-generated schematic environment composed of a dark grid plane, semi-transparent yellow 3D models of trucks, text labels, and illustrative lines.
the Stauffer tow truck: Large tow truck with 'Stauffer' branding on the side and a bar of orange warning lights on the roof.
Marco stands in front of a holographic projection of The Schematic View, gesturing as if explaining a plan. From a high angle, The Schematic View shows animated wireframe models of the Stauffer tow truck and two other tow trucks moving into position around the overturned truck wreckage. Yellow lines and text labels animate across the dark grid, illustrating the recovery procedure.
